{{Quote|Unidentified vessel, this is the ''Nosh vu'Ta'' of the Corsignis line. Please enter orbital pattern gamma above Pinett and await further instructions. Moonside may not be safe for your landing, so please hold.|A crewmeber of the ''Nosh vu'Ta''|<ref name="Hunger">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030619hunger|text=Hunger|int=Hunger (adventure)}}</ref>}}
The '''''Nosh vu'Ta''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was used by the [[Corsignis Property Alliance]], and the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] name translated as "We profit," in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Corsignis and the [[Jon-Tow Economic Development Group]] became engaged in a trade dispute and they both [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]], in attempt to prevent each other from controlling the trade that passed through Pinett's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. The ''Nosh vu'Ta'' participated in the blockade and after a group of agents flew to Pinett, the ''Nosh vu'Ta'' and the Jon-Tow ship ''[[Herriar]]'' both gave conflicting orders to the agents.
